races.paceDynamic: Dashing Donkey is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate a measured, sustainable pace from the gate with no pressure early. Grand Citadel and The Ubermensch may press from prominent positions but lack the natural speed to challenge the leader's rhythm. This creates a controlled tempo that gradually builds, allowing the extensive hold-up brigade to organize behind before the turn. The tactical shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late runs, as they'll benefit from the even gallop and avoid any early tactical squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Donkey sets uncontested fractions and the pace remains steady throughout
scenarios.body: The measured tempo perfectly suits the numerous hold-up runners who can time their challenges and overwhelm the limited early pace. Quality closers like The Spotlight Kid and No Knee Never will have optimal conditions to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays Off
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Donkey maintains the lead and kicks clear when the field starts closing
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a decisive move, while the hold-up horses struggle to peg back a runner with first run on them. Dashing Donkey's solid recent form supports this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Citadel or The Ubermensch press forward to challenge Dashing Donkey earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo hurts the deeper closers while favouring horses that can track the pace and strike with one decisive move. This eliminates the pure hold-up brigade's timing advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace completely collapses and becomes a crawling affair until the final 2f
scenarios.body: The sprint finish from a slow pace scrambles the form book and allows a lesser-rated horse with natural finishing speed to capitalize on the chaos. Fresh legs and tactical positioning become crucial.
